review.notes: Official WordPress source; inspected six workflows, references and Node helper IO/spawn sites. Inspector helpers include local filesystem scans and WP-CLI read queries; WP-CLI can bootstrap local plugins, so only run against trusted authorized installs. Original command examples assume skills/<name>; resolve paths under actual installed skill directory. Targets WordPress 7.0+; verify target version. No WP instance accessed.
review.method: GitHub connector existence check; public GitHub REST metadata+commit+recursive tree; immutable raw file retrieval; static selected-content review. No upstream scripts executed.
